P-mail (Printed Matter) The service rate is 180yen per mail, and 100yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 180yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 100yen
P-mail (Small Packets) The service rate is 350yen per mail, and 100yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 350yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 100yen
